BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to school construction assistance rules; and addinga new section to chapter 28A.300 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 28A.300RCW to read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The office of the superintendent of public instruction shall adoptrules in accordance with chapter 34.05 RCW to ensure that a host schooldistrict is not penalized for the entirety of a shared or colocatedfacility when calculations for state school construction assistance aremade.
